label: Notion → Knowledge Base
description: Hourly poll of a Notion database. Lists every database item, then loads each one into the configured Knowledge Base. Modified-since filtering can be added once the workflow runtime exposes the trigger's last-fired timestamp; until then the KB load action's content-hash dedup prevents re-embedding identical pages.

inputs.name: knowledgeBaseId
inputs.label: Target Knowledge Base
inputs.description: The Knowledge Base to load Notion pages into. Pick from the dropdown after forking — the inputs panel resolves it against the current workspace.

inputs.name: databaseId
inputs.label: Notion Database ID
inputs.description: The Notion database to sync. Open the database in Notion → … menu → Copy link → the id is the 32-char hex segment before the ?v=… query.

tasks.label: Load each page into the Knowledge Base
